nodes.name: JwtService.java
nodes.summary: Central JWT service that generates HS256 access and refresh tokens, validates tokens, and extracts email/role claims used throughout authentication and OAuth2 flows.

nodes.name: OAuth2AuthenticationFailureHandler.java
nodes.summary: Spring Security AuthenticationFailureHandler that clears pending OAuth2 request cookies and redirects the frontend with an error message when OAuth2 login fails.

nodes.name: OAuth2AuthenticationSuccessHandler.java
nodes.summary: Spring Security AuthenticationSuccessHandler invoked after a successful OAuth2 login; issues JWT access/refresh tokens, persists the refresh token, sets cookies, and redirects to the frontend.

nodes.name: SecurityUtils.java
nodes.summary: Static helper for reading the current authenticated user's email from the Spring SecurityContext, throwing UnauthorizedException when no valid principal is present.

nodes.name: TokenHashUtil.java
nodes.summary: Static utility that computes a SHA-256 hex digest of a raw token, used to store refresh and password-reset tokens as hashes rather than plaintext.

nodes.name: AdminService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining admin operations: retrieving user/course metrics and system health, listing users, and updating or deleting user accounts.

nodes.name: AuthService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the authentication contract: login, refresh, logout, and password reset request/completion.

nodes.name: PortfolioSlugService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for allocating a unique, URL-safe portfolio slug for a given User.

nodes.name: UserService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for retrieving the current authenticated user, looking up a user by email, completing profile setup, and updating the avatar.

nodes.name: AdminServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements AdminService: computes user/course growth metrics, aggregates system health (services, DB pool, memory), lists and paginates users, and applies role/status changes with self-demotion protection.

nodes.name: AuthServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements AuthService: username/password login, refresh-token rotation with a grace window, token issuance, logout, and forgot/reset-password flows backed by hashed reset tokens and email delivery.

nodes.name: JwtService
nodes.summary: Spring service wrapping the JJWT library to issue, parse, and validate HS256-signed access and refresh tokens from a configured secret key.

nodes.name: OAuth2AuthenticationFailureHandler
nodes.summary: SimpleUrlAuthenticationFailureHandler that logs the failure, clears OAuth2 request cookies, and redirects to the frontend with an error query parameter.

nodes.name: OAuth2AuthenticationSuccessHandler
nodes.summary: SimpleUrlAuthenticationSuccessHandler that mints JWTs for the newly authenticated OAuth2 user, stores a hashed refresh token, sets cookies, and redirects to the frontend.

nodes.name: SecurityUtils
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable utility class exposing getCurrentUserEmail(), the codebase's standard way to read the authenticated principal's email.

nodes.name: TokenHashUtil
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable utility class providing SHA-256 hex hashing for tokens before persistence.

nodes.name: AdminService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring the admin-facing operations implemented by AdminServiceImpl.

nodes.name: AuthService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring the authentication operations implemented by AuthServiceImpl.

nodes.name: PortfolioSlugService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring slug allocation implemented by PortfolioSlugServiceImpl.

nodes.name: UserService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring user profile operations implemented by UserServiceImpl.

nodes.name: AdminServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Primary implementation of AdminService, wiring UserRepository, CareerRoleRepository, SkillNodeRepository, AdminMapper, the DataSource, and AiServiceClient to serve the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: AuthServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Primary implementation of AuthService, coordinating UserRepository, RefreshTokenRepository, PasswordResetTokenRepository, JwtService, TokenHashUtil, and EmailService to implement login, refresh, logout, and password reset.

nodes.name: generateAccessToken
nodes.summary: Builds and signs a short-lived JWT access token embedding the user's email as subject and role as a claim.

nodes.name: generateRefreshToken
nodes.summary: Builds and signs a long-lived JWT refresh token embedding the user's email as subject.

nodes.name: isTokenValid
nodes.summary: Parses the given JWT and returns whether it is structurally and cryptographically valid, logging a warning on failure.

nodes.name: getClaims
nodes.summary: Parses a JWT with the signing key, enforces the expected HS256 algorithm header, and returns the signed claims payload.

nodes.name: onAuthenticationFailure
nodes.summary: Logs the OAuth2 authentication error, clears authorization-request cookies, and redirects the browser back to the frontend with the error message as a query parameter.

nodes.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
nodes.summary: Entry point invoked by Spring Security after OAuth2 login succeeds; computes the redirect target, guards against a committed response, and clears authentication attributes.

nodes.name: determineTargetUrl
nodes.summary: Generates a fresh JWT access/refresh token pair for the OAuth2 principal, persists the hashed refresh token, sets auth cookies, and builds the final frontend redirect URL.

nodes.name: getCurrentUserEmail
nodes.summary: Reads the current Spring SecurityContext authentication and returns its name (email), throwing UnauthorizedException if absent, unauthenticated, or blank.

nodes.name: sha256Hex
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 digest of a raw token string and encodes it as lowercase hex for safe, one-way storage.

nodes.name: getUserMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes total user count and week-over-week growth percentage, then maps the result via AdminMapper.

nodes.name: getCourseMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes career-role and skill-node coverage counts to derive a course completion percentage for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Probes the database, application, and AI service dependencies, gathers JVM memory and uptime, and assembles an AdminSystemHealthResponse for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: readDbPool
nodes.summary: Reads live HikariCP pool statistics (active, idle, total, max connections) via the DataSource's Hikari MXBean.

nodes.name: getUsers
nodes.summary: Fetches all users and maps each to an AdminUserListItemResponse for the admin user-management table.

nodes.name: updateUserRole
nodes.summary: Looks up a user by id, updates their role, persists the change, and returns the refreshed admin list item.

nodes.name: updateUserStatus
nodes.summary: Updates a user's status (e.g. suspend/activate), forbidding an admin from changing their own status, then persists and returns the updated list item.

nodes.name: deleteUser
nodes.summary: Deletes a user account by id after verifying the acting admin is not deleting their own account.

nodes.name: findUserById
nodes.summary: Internal helper that loads a User by id or throws ResourceNotFoundException, shared by role/status update and delete operations.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Validates username/password credentials, checks account status, and issues an access/refresh token pair on success, using a uniform error for wrong password vs unknown user.

nodes.name: refreshAccount
nodes.summary: Validates the refresh-token JWT and its hashed database record, rotates it within a grace window, and issues a new access/refresh token pair.

nodes.name: issueTokens
nodes.summary: Generates a new access and refresh JWT pair for a user, persists the hashed refresh token with expiry, and prunes old expired tokens.

nodes.name: forgotPassword
nodes.summary: Looks up the user by email, invalidates prior reset tokens, generates and stores a new hashed reset token, and emails a reset link.

nodes.name: resetPassword
nodes.summary: Validates the hashed reset token (unused, unexpired), updates the user's password hash, marks the token used, and revokes existing refresh tokens.

nodes.name: refreshResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a RefreshResponse DTO carrying the new access and refresh token pair returned to the client.
